Breadboard coordinates are read from the image. The catalogue puts rows f-j in bank 'b' and rows a-e in bank 't'. The image's upper half (rows f-j) is therefore bank 'b' and its lower half (rows a-e) is bank 't'. The rails next to the lower half are 'bp' (+, red line) and 'bn' (-, black line).

The button straddles the centre gap. The left pair of legs (column 4) is side 1 and the right pair (column 6) is side 2. Column 4 carries 5V from the orange wire. Column 6 carries the pin-2 wire (teal) and the resistor.
The resistor runs from column 6 to column 9 on the lower half. A short black wire takes column 9 to the GND rail, so it is the pull-down.
The exact rail hole numbers (bp.1, bp.3, bn.1, bn.7) and rows are estimated from the image. Only the strip each one belongs to matters electrically.
The black GND wire goes to the second GND pin of the Uno power header (GND.2).
